_about: MO2A-2: Cloudflare Workers AI answers for the mocked transport (no test reaches Cloudflare). Written on 2026-10-22 from Cloudflare's own docs source, github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs: the success body is the OpenAI Chat Completions shape its /ai/v1/chat/completions endpoint returns (workers-ai/configuration/open-ai-compatibility.mdx, the usage fields of workers-ai-models/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct.json); the error bodies are the Cloudflare API envelope with the codes and messages of workers-ai/platform/errors.mdx. 10000 and 7003 are general Cloudflare API codes (authentication error; an invalid Account ID in the address). Some bodies echo the token: the worst case for leaking it.
